description: This Java class defines the response object for a delete attribute command within an IoT or similar system. It encapsulates details such as the thing ID and attribute pointer, and provides methods for constructing, serializing, and deserializing the response, as well as handling associated headers and JSON payloads.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeResponse
classes.description: Represents the response after deleting an attribute from a Thing, including the thing ID and the attribute pointer, with JSON serialization/deserialization methods and header handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods to create instances of DeleteAttributeResponse either from ThingId, JSON Pointer, headers or from JSON string/object, with deprecation notice for string-based constructor.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserialization methods to create a response object from JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the Thing ID associated with this response.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer of the attribute that was deleted.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path representing the resource location.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends relevant payload data to the JSON object, depending on schema version.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality of this response with another object.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equality checks, confirms if another object can be equal to this.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the object fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
